columns.rewarded: 1 if a reward was delivered, else 0
columns.topups: count of lick top-up reward pulses delivered
columns.return_arm_used: return arm the rat took back to the hub (LEFT/RIGHT)
columns.return_cue_played: return cue tone actually played (HIGH/LOW), if any
columns.trial_start_iso: host wall-clock ISO time the trial started
columns.choice_cue_on_iso: host ISO time the choice cue turned on
columns.choice_cue_off_iso: host ISO time the choice cue turned off
columns.choice_time_iso: host ISO time the choice was scored (entered a choice arm)
columns.reward_cmd_iso: host ISO time the reward command was issued
columns.return_cue_on_iso: host ISO time the return cue turned on
columns.return_cue_off_iso: host ISO time the return cue turned off
columns.trial_end_iso: host ISO time the trial ended
columns.lick_time_iso: host ISO time of the rewarded lick (blank if none)
columns.lick_fw_ms: firmware hardware-clock ms of the lick (see docs/decisions/0047)
columns.sched_state: NORMAL or INTERVENTION (in a corrective/adversarial block)
columns.block_id: 1-based index within an intervention block (blank in NORMAL)
columns.bias: signed directional-error bias at this trial's decision
columns.alt_rate: cue-aware alternation rate at this trial's decision
columns.prime_ms: raw prime reward pulse width (ms) on a rewarded trial
columns.topup_ms_total: sum of this trial's lick top-up pulse widths (ms)
columns.probe: 1 on an unrewarded probe trial, else blank
columns.probe_trigger: 1 on the correct trial that started a probe block
columns.attempt: 1-based attempt number for this trial (append-only edits)
columns.superseded: 1 on a preserved attempt a later Repeat/Back replaced
columns.edit: operator action that created a >1 attempt (repeat/back)
